tsconfigPath.description: Path to a tsconfig file used by ts-morph for type resolution (relative to repo root).

outputFile.description: Generated registry output file path (relative to repo root).

scenarioRoot.description: Root folder where *.component.ts files are considered scenario wrapper components (relative to repo root).

searchRoots.description: Folders to scan for *.scenario.ts metadata and wrapper *.component.ts files (relative to repo root).

ignoredDirNames.description: Directory names to skip when walking searchRoots (e.g. node_modules, dist).
